title: Portrait of the Great Barred Spiral (NGC 1365)

evidence.locator: 3383 x 3263 px; Dark Energy Survey data from DECam on the Blanco 4-metre telescope; the page names no filters. The page states a field of 14.82 x 14.30 arcmin, centre RA 3 33 37.00, Dec -36 8 44.35 and north 0.0 deg left of vertical. On that registration 72 of the 90 Gaia DR3 stars brighter than G = 19 in the frame have a star within 4 px of their places; a search over centre, scale, rotation and mirror finds nothing better than 73 (the recipe's observation). Found in the NOIRLab image archive search for NGC 1365.
